Phase 5 (UI cluster) audit finding. See [docs/audits/cluster-ui.md](docs/audits/cluster-ui.md) findings #1â€“#4, #18, #19.

## Severity rollup

4 P1, 2 P3.

## P1 findings

### #1 â€” Portrait sprites: 29 of 50 missing

**File:** [Main/_Module/ModuleData/career_system/taom_careers.xml](Main/_Module/ModuleData/career_system/taom_careers.xml) (all 50) + [Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerScreenVM.cs:101](Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerScreenVM.cs#L101)

29 of 50 portrait sprites referenced at runtime as ``CareerSystem\Portraits\{career.PortraitSprite}`` have no PNG in ``SpriteParts/ui_taom_career_system/CareerSystem/Portraits/`` and no ``<SpritePart>`` entry in ``TAOMSpriteData.xml``. Affected careers include ``mulkerhili_cultist``, ``snaga_rider``, ``olog_hai_warchief``, ``avanc_luth_raider``, ``wolfskin_hunter``, ``clanguard_rider``, ``blademaster_of_ren``, ``steppe_bowmaster``, ``chariot_warlord``, ``far_harad_halftroll``, ``dale_guardsman``, ``dale_marksman``, ``dale_outrider``, ``crossbow_master``, ``ram_rider``, ``rivendell_knight``, ``warden``, ``galadhrim_archer``, ``sentinel``, ``shadow_walker``, ``elk_rider``, ``warg_scout``, ``goblin_sniper``, ``warg_pack_leader``, ``necromancer_acolyte``, ``fell_rider``, ``corsair_boarder``, ``corsair_crossbow``, ``corsair_captain``.

Silent blank portrait panel â€” no crash, no log.

**Fix:** add 29 missing 800Ã—400 portrait PNGs + corresponding ``<SpritePart>`` entries in ``TAOMSpriteData.xml`` under the ``ui_taom_career_system`` category.

### #2 â€” Ability icon sprites: 41 of 50 missing

**File:** [Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerScreenVM.cs:107](Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerScreenVM.cs#L107) + [Main/_Module/GUI/Prefabs/CareerSystem/CareerScreen.xml:73](Main/_Module/GUI/Prefabs/CareerSystem/CareerScreen.xml#L73)

41 of 50 ability sprite IDs constructed as ``CareerSystem\Abilities\{career.AbilityTemplateId}`` have no PNG and no ``TAOMSpriteData.xml`` entry. Registered: 9 (``captain_of_osgiliath_ability``, ``crossbow_master_ability``, ``eotheod_windrider_ability``, ``ironguard_ability``, ``knight_of_belfalas_ability``, ``marksman_of_aldburg_ability``, ``ram_rider_ability``, ``ranger_of_ithilien_ability``, ``watchman_of_stangard_ability``).

**Fix:** add 41 missing 256Ã—256 ability PNGs to ``SpriteParts/ui_taom_career_system/CareerSystem/Abilities/`` + matching ``<SpritePart>`` entries.

### #3 â€” Choice icons: ALL ``career_choice_*`` missing

**File:** [Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerChoiceObjectVM.cs:49](Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerChoiceObjectVM.cs#L49) + [Main/_Module/GUI/Prefabs/CareerSystem/CareerScreen.xml](Main/_Module/GUI/Prefabs/CareerSystem/CareerScreen.xml) lines 118, 120, 163, 165, 204, 205

``CareerChoiceObjectVM.IconSprite`` returns ``_choice.IconSprite`` directly (e.g. ``career_choice_ranger_of_ithilien_root``). Zero ``career_choice_*`` IDs registered. All choice icons blank for every career, all 3 tiers.

**Fix:** add choice-icon PNGs + ``<SpritePart>`` entries under ``ui_taom_career_system\CareerSystem\Choices\`` (or appropriate subfolder).

### #4 â€” HUD ability icon: same set as #2

**File:** [Main/_Module/GUI/Prefabs/CareerSystem/AbilityHUD.xml:18](Main/_Module/GUI/Prefabs/CareerSystem/AbilityHUD.xml#L18)

``Sprite=\"@AbilitySprite\"`` resolves to the same 41-missing sprite set as #2 â€” blank HUD icon during missions for 41 of 50 careers.

**Fix:** same PNGs as #2 cover this â€” verify the service writes the ``CareerSystem\Abilities\{id}`` convention to ``AbilitySprite``.

## P3 findings

### #18 â€” CareerChoiceDefinition.DisplayName missing

**File:** [Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerChoiceObjectVM.cs:43](Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerChoiceObjectVM.cs#L43)

``Name = new TextObject(_choice.Id).ToString()`` â€” but ``_choice.Id`` is a non-localized technical key. XML at ``taom_career_choices.xml`` has ``display_name`` attributes but ``CareerChoiceDefinition`` has no ``DisplayName`` field. Players see raw IDs like ``ranger_of_ithilien_t1_a_key``.

**Fix:** add ``DisplayName`` to ``CareerChoiceDefinition``, parse from XML, use ``new TextObject(_choice.DisplayName).ToString()``.

### #19 â€” Hardcoded \"Career\" button label

**File:** [Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerButtonPrefab.cs:35](Main/Features/CareerSystem/UI/CareerButtonPrefab.cs#L35)

Inline XML ``Text=\"Career\"`` â€” no binding, no ``{=key}fallback``. Breaks on any non-English locale.

**Fix:** either bind to a mixin ``[DataSourceProperty]`` wrapped in ``new TextObject(\"{=taom_career_button}Career\").ToString()`` or replace inline literal with ``Text=\"{=taom_career_button}Career\"`` if the widget type resolves ``{=key}`` directly.

## Cross-cutting recommendation

The 4 P1s reduce to a single missing build-time gate: nothing validates that XML sprite references resolve to actual PNG + ``TAOMSpriteData.xml`` entries. Consider a ``/verify``-time sprite-coverage check that scans XML for ``Sprite=\"...\"`` / ``*Sprite`` properties and asserts each has a corresponding entry.

Phase 5 (UI cluster) audit finding. See [docs/audits/cluster-ui.md](docs/audits/cluster-ui.md) findings #5, #10.

## Severity rollup

1 P1, 1 P2.

## P1 #5 â€” VM notification fires on host VM, not mixin

**File:** [Main/Features/Messengers/UI/MessengerEncyclopediaMixin.cs:143, 160, 174](Main/Features/Messengers/UI/MessengerEncyclopediaMixin.cs)

All 3 ``[DataSourceProperty]`` setters call:

``` csharp
ViewModel?.OnPropertyChangedWithValue(value, nameof(IsMessengerAvailable));
```

This fires the notification on the HOST ``EncyclopediaHeroPageVM`` (the ``ViewModel`` property of ``BaseViewModelMixin``), not on the mixin itself.

Gauntlet's binding system associates the ``@IsMessengerAvailable``, ``@SendMessengerActionName``, and ``{SendMessengerHint}`` bindings with the mixin's datasource. Notifications must fire on the mixin (``this``), not the host VM. Every other TAOM mixin gets this right â€” ``TimeAccelerationMixin.cs:30``, ``CharacterDeveloperCareerMixin.cs:53`` both call ``OnPropertyChanged(nameof(...))`` on ``this`` (inherited from ``ViewModel`` via ``BaseViewModelMixin``).

**Impact:** the bindings show whatever the mixin computed at first construction, then never update. Re-opening the encyclopedia for different heroes does not refresh the messenger button's enabled state, action name, or hint.

**Fix:** replace all 3 ``ViewModel?.OnPropertyChangedWithValue(value, nameof(X))`` calls with ``OnPropertyChangedWithValue(value, nameof(X))`` (or ``OnPropertyChanged(nameof(X))``) â€” no ``ViewModel?.`` prefix, call on ``this``.

## P2 #10 â€” ``SendMessengerCost`` is a dead ``[DataSourceProperty]``

**File:** [Main/Features/Messengers/UI/MessengerEncyclopediaMixin.cs:149](Main/Features/Messengers/UI/MessengerEncyclopediaMixin.cs#L149)

``SendMessengerCost`` is declared with ``[DataSourceProperty]`` but never referenced by any ``@SendMessengerCost`` binding in the inline prefab XML. The button text shows only ``@SendMessengerActionName``.

gui-ui.md rule: \"Every ``[DataSourceProperty]`` that is set must have a corresponding XML binding â€” unused properties are dead code.\"

**Fix:** either add ``IntText=\"@SendMessengerCost\"`` to a ``TextWidget`` in the inline XML to actually surface cost to the player, OR remove the property + the ``_settings.MessengerGoldCost`` call if displaying cost was intentionally deferred.

## v1.3.15 verification context

- ``EncyclopediaHeroPage`` prefab name confirmed at ``GeneratedUIPrefabCreator.cs:711``.
- XPath target ``descendant::RichTextWidget[@Text='@InformationText']`` confirmed at ``EncyclopediaHeroPage.xml:125`` (installed Sandbox module).
- Parent container is a non-data-bound ``ListPanel`` â€” injection point is safe.

Phase 5 (UI cluster) audit finding. See [docs/audits/cluster-ui.md](docs/audits/cluster-ui.md) findings #6â€“#9, #20, #21.

## Severity rollup

1 P1, 3 P2, 2 P3.

## P1 #6 â€” 8 of 11 special resource icons missing

**Files:** [Main/_Module/ModuleData/special_resources/special_resources_config.xml](Main/_Module/ModuleData/special_resources/special_resources_config.xml) lines 6, 60, 74, 84, 98, 108, 118, 128 + [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs:57](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs#L57)

Registered: ``taom_caster_icon``, ``taom_gems_icon``, ``taom_marks_icon`` (3 only).

Missing: ``taom_war_spoils_icon``, ``taom_elven_wine_icon``, ``taom_lake_fish_icon``, ``taom_war_drums_icon``, ``taom_tribal_relics_icon``, ``taom_dunlending_ale_icon``, ``taom_plunder_icon``, ``taom_war_banners_icon``.

``Context.SpriteData.GetSprite(name)`` returns null; widget silently renders blank (confirmed by widget's own log message).

The widget's log message also has the wrong path: says ``MapBar/`` but should say ``SpecialResources/``.

**Fix:** add 8 PNG files to ``Main/_Module/GUI/SpriteParts/ui_taom/SpecialResources/``, rebuild sprite atlas, verify entries in ``TAOMSpriteData.xml``. Fix log message path.

## P2 #7 â€” ``SecondaryInfoItems.Add`` rule violation

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs:55](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs#L55)

``mapInfo.SecondaryInfoItems.Add(_resourceInfo)`` â€” explicitly forbidden by [.claude/rules/gui-ui.md](.claude/rules/gui-ui.md) \"UIExtenderEx PrefabExtension Safety\".

**v1.3.15 verification:** the originally-documented ``IndexOutOfRangeException`` in ``HandlePanelSwitchingInput`` is NOT reachable in v1.3.15 â€” that method dispatches navigation hotkeys, does not index ``SecondaryInfoItems``. The autogenerated binding code uses ``AddChildAtIndex(widget, e.NewIndex)`` which is index-safe.

**Different real failure mode:** ``MapInfoVM.CreateItems()`` (called on every ``RefreshValues()``) ``Clear()``s and repopulates the list with only 3 vanilla items. When vanilla refresh fires after TAOM's Add (which it routinely does on settlement enter/exit, party composition change, etc.), the TAOM item is silently dropped and ``_itemAdded`` stays ``true`` â†’ permanently suppressed re-insertion. **Feature works on first render and silently loses its UI thereafter.**

Severity is **P2** (degradation, not crash). The fix is the same as the originally-documented case.

**Fix:** bind ``[DataSourceProperty]`` on the mixin + inject the widget into a NON-data-bound container via ``[PrefabExtension]``. See ``gui-ui.md`` \"Safe pattern\" section.

**Also flag:** the rule's \"Why\" paragraph in ``gui-ui.md`` cites ``HandlePanelSwitchingInput`` â€” this is no longer the controlling crash in v1.3.15. Phase 9 doc fix: update the rationale.

Additionally: the ``_baseInitialized`` guard is set at ``SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs:70`` AFTER the Add block at line 55. On the very first ``OnRefresh()`` the guard is false â†’ item is skipped.

## P2 #8 â€” Property assignment ordering

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs:64â€“66](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs#L64)

``_resourceInfo.IntValue`` (line 65) set before ``_resourceInfo.Value`` (line 64). Notification on ``IntValue`` may trigger a one-frame stale render.

**Fix:** assign ``Value`` first, then ``IntValue``.

## P2 #9 â€” PrefabExtension target fragility (6-hop XPath)

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourcePrefab.cs:11â€“12](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourcePrefab.cs#L11)

XPath ``descendant::ListPanel[@Id='BottomInfoBar']/ItemTemplate/HintWidget/Children/ListPanel/Children/IconBrushWidget`` is 6 hops deep into the vanilla ``MapBar.xml`` BottomInfoBar template. Any vanilla restructure (rename, level removal, widget rename) silently breaks injection. The decompiled source is v1.4 â€” may have diverged from v1.3.15.

**Fix:** verify XPath against installed v1.3.15 ``Modules/SandBox/GUI/Prefabs/Map/MapBar.xml``. Document confirmation with a comment.

## P3 #20 â€” Tooltip labels not localized

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs:98, 104, 105, 112â€“117, 121â€“124](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceMapBarMixin.cs#L98)

Hardcoded English ``\"Tier\"``, ``\"Next tier at\"``, ``\"Daily Change\"``, ``\"Income\"``, ``\"Net\"``, ``\"Per battle\"``, etc. â€” no ``TextObject`` wrap.

## P3 #21 â€” Diagnostic flag conflation

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs:45â€“51, 60â€“65, 71](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs#L45)

Single ``_loggedOnce`` flag shared across \"no resource for kingdom\", \"sprite not found\", and successful-load paths. A failure log can suppress a later success log.

**Fix:** split into ``_loggedMissing`` and ``_loggedLoaded``.

Phase 5 (UI cluster) audit finding. See [docs/audits/cluster-ui.md](docs/audits/cluster-ui.md) findings #11, #22.

## Severity rollup

1 P2, 1 P3.

## P2 #11 â€” ``IsExtraFastForwardActive`` watches wrong field

**File:** [Main/Features/TimeAcceleration/UI/TimeAccelerationMixin.cs:54](Main/Features/TimeAcceleration/UI/TimeAccelerationMixin.cs#L54)

``IsExtraFastForwardActive = Campaign.Current.SpeedUpMultiplier > 4f;``

**v1.3.15 verification:**
- ``Campaign.SpeedUpMultiplier`` defaults to ``4f`` (``Campaign.cs:370``).
- In vanilla, ``SpeedUpMultiplier`` is only mutated by the cheat console command ``campaign.set_campaign_speed_multiplier``. No campaign behavior, no GameModel, no patch in TAOM raises it.
- The TAOM button itself fires ``CommandParameter.Click=\"2\"`` â†’ vanilla ``MapTimeControlVM.ExecuteTimeControlChange(2)`` which toggles ``TimeFlowState`` / ``TimeControlMode`` but does NOT touch ``SpeedUpMultiplier``.

**Impact:** ``IsExtraFastForwardActive`` is permanently ``false`` during normal play. The button's selected-state visual (the ``IsSelected=\"@IsExtraFastForwardActive\"`` binding) never activates.

**Fix:** decide intent.

Option A â€” TAOM wants standard speed-2 button (no extra functionality): use ``Campaign.Current.TimeControlMode == CampaignTimeControlMode.StoppableFastForward`` as the state signal. The button becomes redundant with vanilla's ``FastForwardButton``.

Option B â€” TAOM wants actual extra fast forward: the button's command handler must raise ``SpeedUpMultiplier`` itself (via a service). Then ``OnRefresh`` correctly mirrors it.

Without a service call to raise ``SpeedUpMultiplier``, the entire feature is a no-op visually (and probably functionally â€” verify ``ExecuteTimeControlChange(2)`` actually produces the expected extra-fast pacing).

## P3 #22 â€” Hardcoded tooltip English

**File:** [Main/Features/TimeAcceleration/UI/TimeAccelerationMixin.cs:18](Main/Features/TimeAcceleration/UI/TimeAccelerationMixin.cs#L18)

``new BasicTooltipViewModel(() => \"Extra Fast Forward (E)\")`` â€” raw English literal surfaced to UI tooltip.

**Fix:** ``new BasicTooltipViewModel(() => new TextObject(\"{=taom_extra_fast_forward_hint}Extra Fast Forward (E)\").ToString())`` + add the key to TAOM localization XML.

## v1.3.15 verification context

PrefabExtension targets confirmed against installed ``SandBox/GUI/Prefabs/Map/MapBar.xml``:
- ``MapCurrentTimeVisualWidget[@Id='CenterPanel']`` â€” line 110 âœ…
- ``ButtonWidget[@Id='FastForwardButton']`` â€” line 124 âœ…
- ``ButtonWidget[@Id='PlayButton']`` â€” line 130 âœ…
- ``ButtonWidget[@Id='PauseButton']`` â€” line 136 âœ…

Vanilla ``MapCurrentTimeVisualWidget.OnUpdate`` resolves the 3 named buttons by ID at prefab-load. TAOM's extra button uses ``Id=\"FastFastForwardButton\"`` â€” distinct, no collision.

body:
Phase 5 (UI cluster) audit finding. See [docs/audits/cluster-ui.md](docs/audits/cluster-ui.md) findings #12â€“#17, #23â€“#25.

## Severity rollup

6 P2, 3 P3.

Five custom Widget subclasses reviewed: ``MapContainerWidget``, ``FactionImageWidget``, ``PolygonWidget``, ``BannerWidget`` (all in ``Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/``), plus ``SpecialResourceSpriteWidget`` (``Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/``).

All 5 have valid ``(UIContext context) : base(context)`` constructors â†’ no P1 instantiation failures.

## P2 #12 â€” PolygonWidget edge-loop allocations

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:408â€“429](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs#L408)

``OnRender`` allocates one ``SimpleMaterial`` per iteration of the edge-thickness loop (up to 7 per render frame per lifted widget). 60fps Ã— 42 instances on culture-selection screen = ~17k allocs/sec in render path.

**Fix:** allocate one ``SimpleMaterial`` before the loop, mutate its fields per iteration.

## P2 #13 â€” PolygonWidget shadow allocation

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:377â€“397](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs#L377)

Shadow pass ``CreateSimpleMaterial()`` per frame when widget is in non-zero lift. Same hoist-outside-loop fix.

## P2 #14 â€” BannerWidget glow-loop allocations

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/BannerWidget.cs:216â€“241](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/BannerWidget.cs#L216)

8 ``SimpleMaterial`` allocations per render frame per visible non-neutral banner. ~480 allocs/sec per banner.

**Fix:** allocate once before the ``foreach (float ox in offsets)`` loop.

## P2 #15 â€” Static-list race on ``_allInstances``

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:680â€“686](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs#L680)

``ResolveGlobalHover()`` (called from ``OnLateUpdate``) does ``_allInstances.RemoveAt(i)`` while ``OnRender`` does ``_allInstances[0]`` and ``_allInstances[_allInstances.Count - 1]``. No lock; safe only if Gauntlet renders all widgets single-threaded.

**Fix:** snapshot ``_allInstances.Count`` at the top of ``OnRender`` and clamp all index accesses, OR confirm Gauntlet's render threading model via a ``taleworlds-researcher`` decompile of ``GauntletLayer.Update``/``GauntletLayer.Render``. If single-threaded confirmed, document the assumption inline.

## P2 #16 â€” Cross-thread static write â€” ``HoveredFactionName``

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:636â€“648](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs#L636)

``public static string HoveredFactionName`` written in ``OnRender``, read by VM ``OnLateUpdate``. If ``OnRender`` runs on a render thread, this is a data race. Also: VM polls every frame with no invalidation signal.

**Fix:** move the ``HoveredFactionName`` write to ``ResolveGlobalHover()`` (already on ``OnLateUpdate`` path) â€” hover resolution already happens there, the write is just in the wrong method.

## P2 #17 â€” Service locator in widget hot path

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs:39â€“40](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs#L39)

``IoC.Resolve<ISpecialResourceConfigProvider>()`` + ``IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>()`` lazy-init via ``??=`` in ``OnLateUpdate``. DryIoc ``Reuse.Singleton`` resolve acquires a lock on first call.

**Fix:** add ``Initialize(config, logger)`` called once from the prefab-extension owner, or accept via static factory.

## P3 #23 â€” Portability â€” GDI+

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:915â€“956](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs#L915)

``LoadAlphaMapFromPng`` uses ``System.Drawing.Bitmap`` (Windows GDI+). TAOM is Windows-only so not a crash today. Long term: replace with pure-managed PNG alpha reader or ``TaleWorlds.Engine.Texture.GetTextureData()``.

## P3 #24 â€” Dead code â€” ``Points`` property + arrays

**File:** [Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:253â€“263, 1001â€“1032](Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs#L253)

``Points`` ``[Editor]`` property + ``ParsePoints``/``PointsToString`` + ``_pointsX``/``_pointsY``/``_pointCount`` arrays â€” populated but never read. Hit-test uses ``IsMouseOnOpaquePixel`` (alpha map) instead. ~60 lines.

**Fix:** delete the dead code, OR wire the point arrays into the hit-test path as the primary method.

## P3 #25 â€” WidgetFactory registration unverified

**File:** [Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs](Main/Features/SpecialResources/UI/SpecialResourceSpriteWidget.cs)

``SpecialResourcePrefab`` uses ``Replace`` patching with the string name ``\"SpecialResourceSpriteWidget\"``. If TAOM's assembly isn't scanned by ``WidgetFactory.RegisterWidgetTypes``, the Replace silently leaves vanilla ``IconBrushWidget`` in place.

**Fix:** confirm at runtime, OR explicitly register the type in ``OnSubModuleLoad``.

## Cross-cutting recommendation

Two P2 findings (#15, #16) reduce to the same question: is Gauntlet's render loop single-threaded? If yes, both findings drop to P3 (defensive cleanup). If no, both are reproducible crashes/corruption. Spawn a focused decompile task on ``TaleWorlds.GauntletUI.GauntletLayer.Update`` + ``GauntletLayer.Render`` to settle. (Suggested for Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review.)

body:
Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review found two P2 findings in the SmartCavalryAI Ã— MixedFormations Ã— CompanionTactics triplet. Full report: `docs/audits/cluster-cross-feature.md` Â§ Per-pair report 1.

## F1: SmartCavalryAI Ã— MixedFormations handshake is enforced in code but not in tests (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/MixedFormations/FormationLayoutService.cs:74` (`ComputeUnitPlanePosition` returns null when `formation.RepresentativeIsCavalry`) and `:191` (`IsMixedFormationInternal` returns false for cavalry). Both guards carry inline comments citing the 2026-05-06 Codex finding.
- **Gap:** `TAOM.Tests/Features/MixedFormations/FormationLayoutServiceTests.cs` has no test that stubs `IFormationAdapter.RepresentativeIsCavalry.Returns(true)` and asserts the guard fires.
- **Risk:** A future refactor that moves, renames, or conditions either guard will silently re-introduce the original P1 (horse-archer charge-line silently overwritten by MixedFormations layout). Per memory `feedback_cross_feature_handshake_via_shared_adapter.md`.
- **Recommended fix:** Add two tests â€” `ComputeUnitPlanePosition_WhenFormationIsCavalry_ReturnsNull_SmartCavalryAIHandshake` and `IsMixedFormation_WhenFormationIsCavalry_ReturnsFalse_SmartCavalryAIHandshake` â€” each ~10 lines with NSubstitute stubs and a comment naming the cross-feature dependency.

## F2: `CavalryChargeService._states` is lock-free; sibling `FormationLayoutService._layoutByFormation` holds an explicit lock (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/SmartCavalryAI/CavalryChargeService.cs:33` â€” plain `Dictionary<object, CavalryFormationState>`, no `lock` statement. Sibling `Main/Features/MixedFormations/FormationLayoutService.cs:31` holds `_lock` and cites `_MT`-suffix threading pattern + `OrderPositionLock` as rationale.
- **Threading analysis:** v1.4 decompile shows no `_MT`-suffixed caller of `Formation.SetMovementOrder`. Patch31 Postfix and `OnMissionTick` are main-thread today. The asymmetry is a code-review smell; latent race if a future engine path mutates formation state off-thread.
- **Open verification:** Run `ilspycmd "E:/Steam/.../TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.dll" -t TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.Formation` against installed v1.3.15 DLL to confirm no `_MT` caller exists in the shipped version (v1.4 decomp may not match).
- **Recommended fix:** Add `private readonly object _statesLock = new();` and wrap all `_states.TryGetValue` + write pairs. Mirrors the fix already present in `FormationLayoutService`. Critical sections are small; cost is ~25ns/lock.

## Related (P3 in cluster doc, not in this issue)

- F3: Patch35 `CancelStanceOnMove` fires during SmartCavalryAI-internal `IssueStop` calls (recursion guard doesn't gate Patch35). Cosmetic â€” stances are display-only.
- F4: `FormationAdapter._alignmentScratch` is a shared static `List<float>` â€” currently safe.
- F5: `Patch_MissionTime_SetMovementOrder` ordering is alphabetical-by-class-name; no `[HarmonyAfter]`.

## Memory references

- `feedback_cross_feature_handshake_via_shared_adapter.md` (root motivation)
- `feedback_detect_engine_threading_via_mt_suffix.md` (F2)
- `feedback_clamp_nan_infinity_propagates.md`
- `feedback_replicate_vanilla_safety_gates_in_prefix.md`

Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review found two P2 findings in the CharacterCreation Ã— HeroRace Ã— RaceAge triplet. Full report: `docs/audits/cluster-cross-feature.md` Â§ Per-pair report 3.

## F1: Stale/invalid race ID from persisted save flows unvalidated into RaceAge lifespan logic (P2)

- **Producer:** `Main/Features/HeroRace/RacePersistenceService.cs:24â€“34` â€” `CaptureHeroRaces` stores `hero.Race` (raw int) with only a `> 0` guard. No validity check against the live `RaceManager` race list.
- **Consumer:** `Main/Features/RaceAge/RaceAgeService.cs:42â€“53` â€” `GetEntry(int raceId)` calls `_raceManager.GetRaceNameFromId(raceId)`. `RaceManager.GetRaceNameFromId` (`Main/Core/Domain/RaceManager.cs:111â€“131`) logs a warning and caches the `"human"` fallback into `_raceNameCache`. That cached entry is permanent for the session.
- **Observed behavior:** A save made with a now-removed race mod (e.g., `goblin` race module disabled) persists raw integer IDs. On next load `RestoreHeroRaces` writes them into `hero.CharacterObject.Race`. `TaomAgeModel.GetAgeLimitForLocation` and `RaceAgeBehavior.OnDailyTick` call `GetEntry(badId)` â†’ human config caches â†’ elven immortality silently lost, elven pregnancy disabled, dwarf aging wrong for the rest of the session.

## F2: Patch24 blocks `Clan.UpdateBannerColorsAccordingToKingdom` for ALL clans, not only the player (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/BannerColorPersistence/Hooks/Clan_UpdateBannerColorsAccordingToKingdom_Patch.cs:17â€“18` â€” `public static bool Prefix() => !(_service?.IsDriftGuardEnabled() ?? false);` â€” no `__instance` parameter, blocks every clan.
- **Observed behavior:** When DriftGuard is enabled (default true), all NPC clans that change kingdoms mid-campaign never get their banner colors updated to the new kingdom palette. Only the ruling clan is partially re-synced via `Clan_UpdateBannerColor_Patch.Postfix` â†’ `SyncKingdomColors`.
- **Recommended fix:** `public static bool Prefix(Clan __instance) => !(_service?.IsDriftGuardEnabled() ?? false) || __instance != Clan.PlayerClan;` Allows vanilla color sync for NPC clans while protecting the player clan.

## F3: `TargetMethod()` resolves a private method by string with no null-guard log (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/BannerColorPersistence/Hooks/Clan_UpdateBannerColorsAccordingToKingdom_Patch.cs:14â€“15` â€” `AccessTools.Method(typeof(Clan), "UpdateBannerColorsAccordingToKingdom")`. Class has `[HarmonyPatchCategory("Patch24_BannerDriftGuard")]` but no `[HarmonyPatch(...)]` attribute binding because the target is private.
- **Risk:** If TaleWorlds renames the private method in a future patch, `AccessTools.Method` returns null and Harmony silently skips the patch â€” no warning, no log, drift guard goes inert.
- **Recommended fix:** Inject `IModLogger`, change `TargetMethod()` to capture-and-log null: `var m = AccessTools.Method(typeof(Clan), "UpdateBannerColorsAccordingToKingdom"); if (m == null) _logger?.Warning("[BannerDriftGuard] UpdateBannerColorsAccordingToKingdom not found â€” drift guard inactive"); return m;`

## F5: `BannerInjection.InjectBanners` fires before Patch24 is active on new game â€” implicit event-ordering dependency (P2)

- **Code A:** `Main/Features/BannerInjection/BannerInjectionBehavior.cs:17` â€” `CampaignEvents.OnNewGameCreatedEvent.AddNonSerializedListener(this, _ => _service.InjectBanners())`.
- **Code B:** `Main/SubModule.cs:397` â€” `_harmony.PatchCategory("Patch24_BannerDriftGuard")` applied in `OnGameInitializationFinished` (later in the sequence).
- **Observed behavior (today):** Correct because `InjectBanners` re-stamps on top of vanilla drift, then Patch24 activates and freezes the state. For save load, `OnGameLoadedEvent` fires after `OnGameInitializationFinished` so Patch24 IS active â€” asymmetry between new-game and load paths is undocumented.
- **Risk:** If TaleWorlds reorders `OnNewGameCreatedEvent` to fire before clan AfterLoad, injected banners could be overwritten by unguarded drift.
- **Recommended fix:** Add a class comment in `BannerInjectionBehavior` documenting the assumed event ordering. Optionally: assert `IBannerColorService.IsDriftGuardEnabled()` from inside `InjectBanners` and log if not â€” cosmetic given current sequencing.

Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review found 1 P1 + 3 P2 findings in the CareerPassiveHelper integration. Full report: `docs/audits/cluster-cross-feature.md` Â§ Per-pair report 5.

## F1: Service-locator inside a static helper â€” IoC.Resolve not at a boundary (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerPassiveHelper.cs:27, 32` â€” `GetService()` and `GetLogger()` call `IoC.Resolve<...>()` and cache in static fields `_cachedService` and `_cachedLogger`.
- **Issue:** The helper is invoked from inside GameModel override bodies (10 call sites across CulturalFeats, TroopProgression, CareerSystem). Per `feedback_no_service_locator_in_services.md`, acceptable boundaries are Harmony patches, CampaignBehavior ctors, GameModel ctors, SubModule.cs, ScreenBase. A static helper called from a GameModel body is none of these. Static caches are non-volatile â€” visibility across threads not guaranteed by C# memory model.
- **Recommended fix:** Inject `ICareerPassiveService` into each of the 10 GameModel constructors. Pass the service explicitly to `CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor` as a parameter (or inline). Drop the static caches.

## F2: Plain Dictionary â€” data race between RefreshCache and GetPassiveMagnitude (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerPassiveService.cs:11-12, 21, 72` â€” plain `Dictionary<string, Dictionary<PassiveEffectType, float>>`. `RefreshCache` calls `_cache.Clear()` then rebuilds in-place; `GetPassiveMagnitude` calls `_cache.TryGetValue` from GameModel override paths.
- **Threading risk:** Several callers can fire from AI worker threads: `GetTotalWage` (via `DefaultPartyDesertionModel.CalculatePartyDesertionRatio`), `GetPartyMemberSizeLimit` (parallel party-size checks). Per `feedback_detect_engine_threading_via_mt_suffix.md` `_MT` pattern.
- **Symptom under contention:** `InvalidOperationException: Collection was modified` (minimum) or silently wrong return (worst case from partially-visible internal state).
- **Recommended fix:** Snapshot-swap pattern. `RefreshCache` builds a NEW `Dictionary`, then `Volatile.Write` (or `Interlocked.Exchange`) swaps the reference. Reads do `Volatile.Read` before `TryGetValue`. Allocation-on-refresh is acceptable (refresh is infrequent); reads are lock-free.

## F3: Inline foreach + arithmetic in TaomPartyWageModel.GetTotalWage (P1)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/TroopProgression/Models/TaomPartyWageModel.cs:65-79` â€” Rohan mounted-wage-share block: `foreach` over `troopRoster.GetTroopRoster()`, float arithmetic (`mountedWageTotal / baseWageTotal`), conditional guard.
- **Issue:** Per `feedback_gamemodel_inline_logic.md`, any `if`, `foreach`, or multi-step computation inline in a GameModel override body is a violation. The model has `ITroopCostService` injected but the Rohan logic was not extracted to it.
- **Recommended fix:** Add `float GetMountedWageShareFactor(TroopRoster roster, Func<CharacterObject, int> wageFunc)` to `ITroopCostService`. Move lines 65-79 there. Model body becomes service delegate call.

## F4: Integer truncation before career passive in TaomSmithingModel (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/CulturalFeats/Models/TaomSmithingModel.cs:46, 51` â€” `ApplySmithingFeatReduction` computes `featResult = (int)(baseCost * (1f + factor))` at line 46, then `new ExplainedNumber(featResult, false)` + `CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor`.
- **Bug:** Intermediate `(int)` truncation shifts the result by 1 vs same-line `ExplainedNumber.AddFactor` composition. Example: baseCost=7, Erebor=-0.3, career=-0.1 â†’ truncated path gives 3; composed path gives 4.
- **Recommended fix:** `var result = new ExplainedNumber(baseCost, false); result.AddFactor(featFactor, ...); CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor(...); return (int)result.ResultNumber;` Single int cast at the end is unavoidable; intermediate truncation eliminated.

## Related (P3 in cluster doc, not in this issue)

- F5: 12 aspirational `PassiveEffectType` values with no producers + no consumers. Plus `StealthBonus` with XML producers but no C# consumer. Per `feedback_no_aspirational_enum_values.md`.

Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review found 1 P2 finding in the SpecialResources Ã— CareerSystem inventory-upgrade pair. Full report: `docs/audits/cluster-cross-feature.md` Â§ Per-pair report 6.

## F2: Career discount applies to gate decision but NOT to actual resource debit â€” player overpays (P2)

- **Gate (uses discount):** `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourceService.cs:212-228` â€” `ClampUpgradeCount` calls `GetEffectiveUpgradeCost` which applies the `CustomResourceUpgradeCostModifier` passive.
- **Debit (ignores discount):** `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourceService.cs:195-203` â€” `QueueUpgradeSpend` queues `cost.UpgradeCost * count` (base cost, no passive applied).
- **Concrete example:** Player has `CustomResourceUpgradeCostModifier = -0.30` (e.g., `knight_of_belfalas_t3_a_p4` in `taom_career_choices.xml:547`). 10 war-spoils available, base cost 5 each. `ClampUpgradeCount` allows `floor(10/3.5) = 2` upgrades (correct, with discount). `QueueUpgradeSpend` accumulates `5Ã—2 = 10`. `CommitSession` at line 239 debits 10. Player ends at 0 war-spoils instead of 3. The career discount is active for the allow/capacity decision but silently inert for the actual debit.
- **Recommended fix:** `QueueUpgradeSpend` must call `GetEffectiveUpgradeCost(heroId, cost.UpgradeCost, 1) * count` instead of bare `cost.UpgradeCost * count`. `heroId` is already a parameter; the gap is the service not threading it through to the effective-cost call.

Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review found 2 P2 findings in FactionMap's static-state lifecycle at CC re-entry boundaries. Full report: `docs/audits/cluster-cross-feature.md` Â§ Per-pair report 8.

## F6: `_factionVM` static stale on CC backward navigation (P2)

- **Code A:** `Main/Features/FactionMap/Hooks/CultureStageViewCreatedHook.cs:25` â€” `private static FactionSelectionVM? _factionVM`
- **Code B:** `Main/Features/FactionMap/Hooks/CultureStageViewFinalizeHook.cs:7â€“8` â€” `Cleanup()` sets `_factionVM = null`.
- **Scenario:** Player navigates backward from Culture stage â†’ prior CC stage â†’ forward again. Engine sequence may be `construct-new â†’ finalize-old` (Finalize fires AFTER next Constructor). In that window, the old `_factionVM` is briefly alive while the new session initializes.
- **Risk:** The tick patch calls `CultureStageViewCreatedHook.CurrentVM?.OnTick(dt)`. If it runs before `Cleanup()`, it ticks the old VM's hover service with the new widget state (now cleared by `ResetSession()`), producing stale `HoveredFactionName = ""` for 0â€“1 frames.
- **Recommended fix:** Call `Cleanup()` as the first statement in `CultureStageViewCreatedHook.OnCreated()` BEFORE `ResetSession()` â€” guarantees `_factionVM = null` regardless of Finalize timing.

## F7: `_pendingPins` static list not cleared in `ResetSession()` (P2)

- **Code:** `Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:85-86` â€” `private static readonly List<PinRenderData> _pendingPins`.
- **Code:** `Main/Features/FactionMap/Widgets/PolygonWidget.cs:120-130` â€” `ResetSession()` clears `_allInstances`, `_globalHovered`, `_nextPlayableIndex`, `_totalPlayable`, `_globalPulseTimer/Index/Alpha`, and `HoveredFactionName` â€” but NOT `_pendingPins`.
- **Risk:** Static pin list survives CC re-entry. The `_pendingPins.Clear()` at line 362 fires correctly on the next "first instance" path, BUT the pin-draw guard at line 593 (`_allInstances[Count-1] == this`) can fire from multiple widgets in the first few frames after re-entry while the new `_allInstances` is still growing â€” resulting in multi-render of pins per frame.
- **Recommended fix:** Add `_pendingPins.Clear()` to `ResetSession()`.

## Phase 5 carryovers settled (resolved or downgraded in cluster doc, not in this issue)

- F3 (was Phase 5 #15 P2): `_allInstances` LateUpdate write vs Render read â€” **DOWNGRADE to P3.** Gauntlet single-threaded for TAOM widgets (`PolygonWidget` does not override `OnParallelUpdate`).
- F4 (was Phase 5 #16 P2): `HoveredFactionName` dual-write from OnRender + OnLateUpdate â€” **DOWNGRADE to P3.** Same engine thread; semantic smell only. Move the pulse-name write to LateUpdate.
- F5 (was Phase 5 #25 P3): `WidgetFactory` registration â€” **RESOLVED for FactionMap.** Engine `WidgetInfo.CollectWidgetTypes()` assembly-scan handles all 4 FactionMap widget types automatically.

## Related (P3 in cluster doc, not in this issue)

- F1: Patch9_RaceFilter and FactionMap operate on different CC stages â€” no lifecycle overlap. Add clarifying comments.
- F2: `ResetSession()` is constructor-only â€” if patch bypassed, stale state persists. Add `OnDisconnectedFromParent` cleanup belt-and-suspenders.

## Gauntlet threading verdict (Phase 5 carryover)

Verified via v1.4 decomp of `GauntletLayer`, `EventManager`, `Widget`, `WidgetInfo`. `LateUpdate` and `RenderTick` are sequential on the engine main thread. `PolygonWidget` does NOT override `OnParallelUpdate` â†’ never enters the `ParallelUpdate` container. **TAOM widget types are strictly single-threaded under v1.3.15.**
